components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()\d\s-]+$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: '5b8e2a44-1f3c-3e9a-9c7d-0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1

## What I changed

The `membershipNumber` is a derived, read-only field computed purely from the owner's own `customerCode` and `registrationDate`, so I added it as a mapping expression rather than storing or computing it in any control-flow-heavy method.

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipNumber` read-only property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping` expression to `toOwnerDto`:
   ```java
   owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + String.format("%02d", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100)
   ```
   This yields e.g. `SMI-0007-M26` (year `2026` → `26`, zero-padded to two digits, matching the test's `registrationDate.substring(2,4)`).

## Why this keeps structural impact low
- Only **two files** touched, and only **one function** materially changed (`toOwnerDto`, an annotation-only mapstruct interface method with CC = 1 and small `WMC_other` — the `OwnerMapper` interface has little surrounding complexity).
- I avoided touching the large `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` method / controller class (huge `WMC_other`) and the many-method `Owner` entity. The value is derived at mapping time from fields already populated before serialization (`customerCode` set in the controller, `registrationDate` defaulted to non-null in its setter), so no new stored state or extra branching was needed.
